column1: Data dictionary for Strickland and others (2022, USGS North American Packrat Midden Database, Version 5.0,  U.S. Geological Survey Data Release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P91UOARW)

[Note: In the Access database and .xlsx and .csv files, not all midden samples have complete data. Generally, cells that contain “99999” indicate that published data were not available, or data were unable to be generated (for example, ecoregion or best location fields).  Blank cells may also indicate that published data were not available (location data fields) or blank cells may appear in unused fields such as notes or comments, fields with flags, and secondary data fields.  The abbreviation “n/a” (not applicable) was used when it was not applicable to record data in a cell.]

Name of the taxon distribution map in Thompson and others (2015) that best represents the midden taxon.  This name comes from the original mapped distribution source publication; therefore the atlas taxon name may not be the currently accepted name of the taxon.  We did not indicate distribution map availability for midden taxa without species level identifications or for taxa with some degree of uncertainty in the species identification such as names containing “cf.” or “‑type”.  It is likely that midden taxa identified at the variety or subspecies level are included in species level map coverages; however we only list map coverage availability in association with species level midden taxa and not for individual varieties or subspecies.  Digital versions of species distribution maps from Thompson and others (2015) can be viewed online at http://dx.doi.org/10.3133/pp1650G.
